svg.title: Protocol-Dependent Verdicts in Offline Reinforcement Learning
svg.desc: A realistic cutaway landscape through a full day and night, with birds, fireflies, a rare gust of wind, thunderstorms, shooting stars and aurora: moon, dawn, sun and dusk cross a mountain valley while rain showers pass at irregular moments. Beneath a village well, a textured soil profile shows an aquifer, a falling water table, and a gold groundwater forecast with an uncertainty band.

g.text: An audit of estimator, baseline, and distribution
sensitivity on a groundwater pumping task.
